title: Seeing Billie Holiday at the Big Apple, and what she thought of her
summary: Friends from Albany drove her to New York to hear Billie Holiday at the Big Apple, where she saw Billie pull up her dress to collect money. Humes says it was not her style but remembers Billie as a lovely, harmless person who once got her into a locked dressing room.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Now listen, while you were there in Albany, you visited Virginia Scott and Joy, didn't you?
Yeah, they used to work together. They worked with Claude.
What was his instrument?
Tenor. They were the ones who took me the first time I heard Billie Holiday.
Really?
They took me to New York for the day.
Really?
